propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml performs duplicate work already covered by test matrix cells in _build-and-test.yml with strictly more platform/version combinations.

Deleting the import-linter job without a guard risks future contributors accidentally removing the only mechanism ensuring tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py remain collected by the default suite selection.

A collection-based test asserting 9 items are collected from the two files under default marker filtering will catch marker additions, file moves, or path filters that would silently break optionality coverage.

Existing workflow parity checks (test_ci_workflow_parity.py and check_verify_gate_parity.py) have no visibility into _optionality.yml inner job structure and cannot detect the deletion, so explicit collection coverage must replace the implicit guard.
